reason: Counterexample. The convex but not strictly convex I(x,y)=x^2 on R^2 has the whole line x=0 as its minimiser set, showing strict convexity in the uniqueness corollary cannot be dropped. Sources [T] Corollary 13.4 and Example 13.5, [CV] Chapter 2 Section 2.4; dependencies are local definition items.
